t: 墨西哥的莱昂市由代市长唐·马丁·恩里克斯·德·阿尔曼萨下令建立.
te: The Mexican city of León is founded by order of the viceroy Don Martín Enríquez de Almanza.
dz: 墨西哥的莱昂市由代市长唐·马丁·恩里克斯·德·阿尔曼萨下令建立.
de: The Mexican city of León is founded by order of the viceroy Don Martín Enríquez de Almanza.

t: 纳瓦雷的亨利在图尔斯放弃了天主教,并重新加入了法国宗教战争中的新教势力.
te: Henry of Navarre abjures Catholicism at Tours and rejoins the Protestant forces in the French Wars of Religion.
dz: 纳瓦雷的亨利在图尔斯放弃了天主教,并重新加入了法国宗教战争中的新教势力.
de: Henry of Navarre abjures Catholicism at Tours and rejoins the Protestant forces in the French Wars of Religion.

t: 杰罗姆·萨维奇(英语:Jerome Savage)拿出了分租合同,在伦敦外创办了"纽顿巴特斯剧…
te: Jerome Savage takes out a sub-lease to start the Newington Butts Theatre outside London.
dz: 杰罗姆·萨维奇(英语:Jerome Savage)拿出了分租合同,在伦敦外创办了"纽顿巴特斯剧院".
de: Jerome Savage takes out a sub-lease to start the Newington Butts Theatre outside London.

t: 在探索北大西洋试图寻找西北航道时，马丁·弗罗比舍看到了格陵兰岛，并将其误认为是假设的（但不存在…
te: While exploring the North Atlantic Ocean in an attempt to find the Northwest Passage, Martin Frobisher sights Greenland…
dz: 在探索北大西洋试图寻找西北航道时，马丁·弗罗比舍看到了格陵兰岛，并将其误认为是假设的（但不存在的）“弗里斯兰”岛。
de: While exploring the North Atlantic Ocean in an attempt to find the Northwest Passage, Martin Frobisher sights Greenland, mistaking it for the hypothesized (but non-existent) island of "Frisland".

t: 莫卧儿帝国在拉杰马哈尔战役中击败了孟加拉苏丹国后吞并了孟加拉.
te: Mughal Empire annexes Bengal after defeating the Bengal Sultanate at the Battle of Rajmahal.
dz: 莫卧儿帝国在拉杰马哈尔战役中击败了孟加拉苏丹国后吞并了孟加拉.
de: Mughal Empire annexes Bengal after defeating the Bengal Sultanate at the Battle of Rajmahal.

t: Tycho Brahe的乌拉尼博格天文台的基石被铺入了赫文岛.
te: The cornerstone for Tycho Brahe's Uraniborg observatory is laid on the island of Hven.
dz: Tycho Brahe的乌拉尼博格天文台的基石被铺入了赫文岛.
de: The cornerstone for Tycho Brahe's Uraniborg observatory is laid on the island of Hven.

t: 在佛兰德斯,西班牙攻克了安特卫普(三天后几乎被摧毁了).
te: In Flanders, Spain captures Antwerp (which is nearly destroyed after three days).
dz: 八十年战争:在佛兰德斯,西班牙攻克了安特卫普(三天后几乎被摧毁了).
de: Eighty Years' War: In Flanders, Spain captures Antwerp (which is nearly destroyed after three days).

t: 根特平和:荷兰国将相会并团结起来反对西班牙占领.
te: Pacification of Ghent: The States General of the Netherlands meet and unite to oppose Spanish occupation.
dz: 八十年战争:根特平和:荷兰国将相会并团结起来反对西班牙占领.
de: Eighty Years' War: Pacification of Ghent: The States General of the Netherlands meet and unite to oppose Spanish occupation.
